segments.sn8.1:1.1: Evaṃ me sutaṃ – ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā vaṅgīso āḷaviyaṃ viharati aggāḷave cetiye āyasmatā nigrodhakappena upajjhāyena saddhiṃ.
segments.sn8.1:1.3: Tena kho pana samayena āyasmā vaṅgīso navako hoti acirapabbajito ohiyyako vihārapālo.
segments.sn8.1:1.4: Atha kho sambahulā itthiyo samalaṅkaritvā yena aggāḷavako ārāmo tenupasaṅkamiṃsu vihārapekkhikāyo.
segments.sn8.1:1.5: Atha kho āyasmato vaṅgīsassa tā itthiyo disvā anabhirati uppajjati, rāgo cittaṃ anuddhaṃseti.
segments.sn8.1:1.7: “alābhā vata me, na vata me lābhā; dulladdhaṃ vata me, na vata me suladdhaṃ;
segments.sn8.1:1.8: yassa me anabhirati uppannā, rāgo cittaṃ anuddhaṃseti, taṃ kutettha labbhā, yaṃ me paro anabhiratiṃ vinodetvā abhiratiṃ uppādeyya.
segments.sn8.1:1.9: Yaṃnūnāhaṃ attanāva attano anabhiratiṃ vinodetvā abhiratiṃ uppādeyyan”ti.
segments.sn8.1:1.10: Atha kho āyasmā vaṅgīso attanāva attano anabhiratiṃ vinodetvā abhiratiṃ uppādetvā tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imā gāthāyo abhāsi –
segments.sn8.1:4.1: “Sacepi etato [ettato (sī. pī. ka.), ettakā (syā. kaṃ.)] bhiyyo, āgamissanti itthiyo;
segments.sn8.1:4.3: Neva maṃ byādhayissanti [byāthayissanti (?)], dhamme samhi patiṭṭhitaṃ.
segments.sn8.1:5.3: Nibbānagamanaṃ maggaṃ, tattha me nirato mano.
segments.sn8.1:6.3: Tathā maccu karissāmi, na me maggampi dakkhasī”ti.

lines: Anuppanne buddhe aggāḷavagotamakādīni yakkhanāgādīnaṃ bhavanāni, cetiyāni ahesuṃ.
Uppanne buddhe tāni apanetvā manussā vihāre kariṃsu.
Vihārapāloti so kira tadā avassiko hoti pattacīvaraggahaṇe akovido.
“āvuso, imāni chattupāhanakattarayaṭṭhiādīni olokento nisīdā”ti vihārarakkhakaṃ katvā piṇḍāya pavisiṃsu.
Taṃ kutettha labbhāti etasmiṃ rāge uppanne taṃ kāraṇaṃ kuto labbhā.
Yaṃ me paroti yena me kāraṇena añño puggalo vā dhammo vā anabhiratiṃ vinodetvā idāneva abhiratiṃ uppādeyya ācariyupajjhāyāpi maṃ vihāre ohāya gatā.
Sahassaṃ apalāyinanti ye te samantā sarehi parikireyyuṃ, tesaṃ apalāyīnaṃ saṅkhaṃ dassento “sahassan”ti āha.
Neva maṃ byādhayissantīti maṃ cāletuṃ na sakkhissanti.
Dhamme samhi patiṭṭhitanti anabhiratiṃ vinodetvā abhiratiṃ uppādanasamatthe sake sāsanadhamme patiṭṭhitaṃ.
Idaṃ vuttaṃ hoti – issāsasahasse tāva samantā sarehi parikirante sikkhito puriso daṇḍakaṃ gahetvā sabbe sare sarīre apatamāne antarāva paharitvā pādamūle pāteti.
Tattha ekopi issāso dve sare ekato na khipati, imā pana itthiyo rūpārammaṇādivasena pañca pañca sare ekato khipanti.
Evaṃ khipantiyo etā sacepi atirekasahassā honti, neva maṃ cāletuṃ sakkhissantīti.
Sakkhī hi me sutaṃ etanti mayā hi sammukhā etaṃ sutaṃ.
So hi nibbānassa pubbabhāgamaggo, liṅgavipallāsena pana “maggan”ti āha.
Tattha meti tasmiṃ me attano taruṇavipassanāsaṅkhāte nibbānagamanamagge mano nirato.
Na me maggampi dakkhasīti yathā me bhavayoniādīsu gatamaggampi na passasi, tathā karissāmīti.
Taṃ kira bhūmirāmaṇeyyakabhāvena manuññatāya padhānayuttatādisampattiyā ca itaracetiyehi seṭṭhasammataṃ.
Kappattherenāti “kappo”ti gottato āgatanāmo thero, sahassapurāṇajaṭilānaṃ abbhantare ayaṃ mahāthero.
Ohīnakoti theresu gāmaṃ piṇḍāya paviṭṭhesu vihāre eva avahīnako ṭhito.
“Ekasmin”ti vā pāṭho, ekasmiṃ visabhāgavatthuke rāge uppanne.
Dhammo vāti mama citte uppajjanakato añño dhammo vā.
Yena kāraṇena paro anabhiratiṃ vinodetvā idāneva abhiratiṃ uppādeyya, taṃ kāraṇaṃ kuto labbhāti yojanā, taṃ kāraṇaṃ natthīti attho, tassa abhāvakāraṇavacanaṃ.
Tattha niyuttattā anagāriyaṃ ka-kārassa ya-kāraṃ katvā, pabbajitanti attho.
